title: Max-three-SAT predicate template
statement: The max-three-SAT template has a predicate for each triple of Boolean negation flags and has arity three. On a triple of Boolean inputs, it evaluates the three-literal satisfaction predicate: it is true exactly when at least one negation flag differs from its corresponding input.
